systems.system: Loi n°1/03 du 10 mars 2026 (conditional cross-border transfer regime)

note: Classes Burundi's transfer regime as conditional (a safeguard condition on sending data abroad, noted not staged); states no Burundi rule that data must stay in the country.
Article 15 of Law 1/03 sets an adequacy condition on transfers abroad, which is not a rule that data must stay in the country.
